desc: A Barrel Bushing Wrench is an indispensable part of every shooters kit and is absolutely necessary for disassembling guns with tight-fitting bushings. The blued steel wrench fits all 1911 Autos except Colt Officers Model. The super- tough polymer bushing wrench is perfect for removing barrel bushings on Government and Officers style 1911s without scratching the gun. You'll need two or three so you'll always have one handy when you need it.
